facebook.content_angle: How East Auckland sellers who get their open home presentation right in the final weeks of autumn consistently attract more serious buyers before the winter slowdown arrives
facebook.post_text:
Your open home could be costing you buyers — and you might not even know it. 🚪

Most East Auckland sellers focus everything on price and marketing. But buyers decide how they feel about a home within the first 90 seconds of walking through the door.

👉 The way a home smells, flows, and feels on arrival sets the emotional tone before a single room is inspected
👉 Small friction points — cluttered hallways, dark living areas, closed curtains — quietly kill buyer confidence
👉 Sellers who fix these details before their first open home consistently attract more offers and stronger ones

With the winter slowdown arriving in June, this autumn window is your best chance to put your best foot forward. ❤️

✔️ Walk through your home as a buyer would before every open
✔️ Maximise natural light — open every curtain and blind
✔️ Clear entrance areas so buyers feel welcomed the moment they arrive

If you are preparing to list in East Auckland and want to make sure your open home lands the right way, I would love to help you get it right from day one.

What is the one thing you always notice first when walking into an open home?
